declared_permissions.name: scripting
declared_permissions.justification: Allows the extension to inject scripts and styles into matching pages dynamically.

declared_permissions.name: sidePanel
declared_permissions.justification: Enables the right-side always-on assistant panel for chat and agent services.

declared_permissions.name: tabs
declared_permissions.justification: Allows querying tab states and controlling active pages.

declared_permissions.name: notifications
declared_permissions.justification: Allows showing custom notifications, announcements, and dunning alerts.

declared_permissions.name: cookies
declared_permissions.justification: Used to monitor user auth session cookies on grammarly.com and sync credentials.

declared_permissions.name: identity
declared_permissions.justification: Integrates with OAuth/Google/SSO login flows to authenticate users.

declared_permissions.name: storage
declared_permissions.justification: Enables local, session, and managed storage APIs to save states and sync settings.

host_permissions.justification: Enables Grammarly text checking across arbitrary non-secure websites.
Enables Grammarly text checking across arbitrary secure websites.

optional_permissions.name: nativeMessaging
optional_permissions.justification: Optionally allows connection to a local Grammarly desktop app client.

optional_permissions.name: clipboardRead
optional_permissions.justification: Optionally allows the extension to read from the system clipboard for text insertion or checks.
